notes: The starter cave has an opt-in debris skirt at its outside foot. Set WAR_CAVE_FOOT_TALUS=1 before launch to gather broken stone where the massif meets the Reach; the ordinary game remains unchanged while the treatment is judged.

The stones follow the cave's real ground-contact surface instead of appearing as an unrelated scatter. They fall outward onto the local terrain, leave the doorway clear and gather asymmetrically around the flanks.
The treatment is scenery only. It adds no collision, reward, resource or saved state, and it does not alter the cave rock players walk through.

Still short of the mark: the smooth massif itself has not gained broken planar faces, and the seam still lacks drifted ash, dirt buildup and returning scrub. This is the loose-stone layer, not a claim that the cave now fully belongs to the terrain.
title: Broken stone gathers at the cave foot
